description: Combine the 256-thread padded n=4096 global-best stack with the direct compact batch-one large-shape winner. Slice build, all tests, fresh-input guard, and all cells passed. n8192/n16384/n32768 measured 4432.906/14076.277/51593.810 us; aggregate improved from 801.021 to 797.539 us.
